evidence.quote: When you create a new account, AWS Control Tower automatically removes the AWS default VPC and creates a new VPC for that account.
When you enroll an existing account, AWS Control Tower does not create a new VPC for that account.
When you enroll an existing account, AWS Control Tower does not remove any existing VPC or AWS default VPC associated with the account.
You can change the default behavior for new accounts by configuring Account Factory, so it does not set up a VPC by default for accounts in your organization under AWS Control Tower.
